signInIntro: Use the email address your invitation was sent to.
rememberEmail: Remember this email on this device
mfaIntro: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
enrolIntro: Scan this code with an authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code it shows.
enrolSecretLabel: Or key in this code by hand
recoveryIntro: Each code works once, and we cannot show them again. Keep them somewhere safe in case you lose your phone.
activationIntro: Welcome, {{name}}. Choose a password for {{email}} and your account is ready.
bootstrapIntro: Choose a password for {{email}}. After this, everyone else is invited from inside the portal.
passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter, a number and a symbol.
mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
forgotIntro: Tell us your email address and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgotSent: If that address has an account, a link is on its way. The link expires in one hour.
signedInIntro: Your account is ready to use.
accountSignInFirst: Sign in to manage your security settings.
accountPasswordHelp: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else.
accountMfaHelp: A code from an app on your phone, asked for after your password.
accountMfaRequired: Noatum accounts keep a second factor, so it can be moved to a new phone but not turned off.
accountMfaPasswordHint: We ask for your password before changing how your account is protected.
accountSessionsHelp: If you have used a shared or public computer, end those sessions here.
expired: This link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
throttled: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.
unavailable: We cannot reach the portal just now. Try again shortly.
staffSignInHeading: Or sign in with a portal password
staffSignInIntro: For Noatum accounts that do not use Microsoft sign-in.
